title.zh: CoinDCX 热钱包及存款地址约 1600 万美元 USDT 与 TRX 可疑流出，交易所承认旧钱包清退失败造成损失
title.en: 【Salus CMO：CoinDCX 疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT 及部分 TRX】

current_state.zh: 该约 1600 万美元的 CoinDCX 可疑资金外流事件已从 Salus 的初步疑似被盗报告，发展为 CoinDCX 承认旧钱包资金因归集失败形成运营损失、但否认误导，并与链上调查人员就地址归属和资金性质存在公开争议。
current_state.en: The roughly $16 million CoinDCX suspicious outflow has moved from Salus’s initial suspected-theft report to a public dispute: CoinDCX acknowledges operational losses from failed sweeping of old compromised wallets while denying misleading statements, and blockchain investigators contest its account of address ownership and fund movement.

updates.title_zh: 【Salus CMO：CoinDCX 疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT 及部分 TRX】
updates.title_en: 【Salus CMO：CoinDCX 疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT 及部分 TRX】
updates.what_changed_zh: Salus 首席营销官报告称，10 月 21 日约有 1599 万 USDT 和 5,783.81 TRX 从 CoinDCX 热钱包和充值地址转出至一个 TRON 地址，随后资金被拆分并转往 Binance、OKX 和 Gate 的充值地址，此事被描述为疑似盗窃。
updates.what_changed_en: Salus's CMO reported that roughly 15.99 million USDT and 5,783.81 TRX moved out of CoinDCX hot wallets and deposit addresses to a TRON address on October 21, with the funds subsequently split and transferred toward Binance, OKX and Gate deposit addresses, in what is being described as a suspected theft.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️ZachXBT质疑CoinDCX：1580万美元用户存款去向不明
updates.title_en: ⚡️ZachXBT质疑CoinDCX：1580万美元用户存款去向不明
updates.what_changed_zh: ZachXBT 声称约 1580 万美元的 CoinDCX 用户存款仍下落不明，且一个与 2025 年安全事件相关的充值地址仍在收取用户资金并将其转入 CoinDCX 当前热钱包，CoinDCX 对此予以否认。
updates.what_changed_en: ZachXBT alleged that about $15.8 million in CoinDCX user deposits remains unaccounted for and that a deposit address linked to a 2025 security incident continued collecting user funds and routing them to CoinDCX's current hot wallet, claims CoinDCX disputes.

updates.title_zh: 区块链调查人员称加密交易所 CoinDCX 就 1600 万美元黑客事件“撒谎”
updates.title_en: Crypto exchange CoinDCX ‘lying’ about $16M hack, say blockchain investigators
updates.what_changed_zh: CoinDCX 回应称相关地址是 2025 年 1 月创建、2025 年 7 月已被攻破且不再使用的旧钱包，并将约 1600 万美元损失称为“部分运营损失”；链上调查人员反驳其说法，指其前后表述矛盾，且资金最终流向与旧事件不同的洗钱地址。
updates.what_changed_en: CoinDCX responded that the addresses were old wallets created in January 2025 and compromised in July 2025, claimed they were no longer in use, and described the roughly $16 million as “operational losses”; blockchain investigators disputed the account, citing contradictory statements and laundering routes that differed from last year’s hack.
updates.current_state_zh: 该约 1600 万美元的 CoinDCX 可疑资金外流事件已从 Salus 的初步疑似被盗报告，发展为 CoinDCX 承认旧钱包资金因归集失败形成运营损失、但否认误导，并与链上调查人员就地址归属和资金性质存在公开争议。
updates.current_state_en: The roughly $16 million CoinDCX suspicious outflow has moved from Salus’s initial suspected-theft report to a public dispute: CoinDCX acknowledges operational losses from failed sweeping of old compromised wallets while denying misleading statements, and blockchain investigators contest its account of address ownership and fund movement.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Blockchain investigators accused CoinDCX of misrepresenting $16M in suspicious on-chain transfers, while the exchange said the wallets were old addresses compromised in July 2025 and no longer in use.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Blockchain investigators accused CoinDCX of misrepresenting $16M in suspicious on-chain transfers, while the exchange said the wallets were old addresses compromised in July 2025 and no longer in use.
